name: behaviour-lens
description: Turn a daily human-behaviour observation into a concise evidence-backed brief and accumulate longitudinal pattern reviews in Obsidian.

interface.shortDescription: Research daily observations; reveal attention patterns.
interface.longDescription: Behaviour Lens treats each observation as a hypothesis, builds a five-minute research and current-affairs brief, saves it as structured Markdown, and produces cautious weekly, monthly, and quarterly reviews of what your notes attend to.
defaultPrompt: Analyse and save this observation: people seem…
Review my observation patterns this week.
Compare my attention patterns this quarter.
